title: Small-study effects + publication-bias sensitivity
description: Gate asymmetry diagnostics on adequate study counts, select tests compatible with each meta-analysis, and report robustness without treating asymmetry as proof of publication bias.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: publication-bias-detection
  title: Small-study effects + publication-bias sensitivity
  description: Gate asymmetry diagnostics on adequate study counts, select tests compatible with each meta-analysis, and report robustness without treating asymmetry as proof of publication bias.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce cautious, outcome-level small-study-effect diagnostics and sensitivity conclusions with explicit limitations.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [bias-lead-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: meta-analysis-input
      kind: input
      name: Meta-analytic estimates, study-level data, and analysis plan
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [outcomeEstimates, studyLevelData, analysisPlan]
        properties:
          outcomeEstimates: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/json }
          studyLevelData: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/json }
          analysisPlan: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/json }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: power-check
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Check whether asymmetry testing is adequately powered
      role: Independent statistical feasibility evaluator
      prompt: >-
        Count compatible studies for each outcome and return has-testable when at least one outcome has 10 or more
        studies. Label outcomes with fewer than 10 studies as underpowered for funnel-plot-asymmetry testing,
        retain them in the limitations report, and do not interpret a non-significant test as evidence that
        reporting bias is absent.
      capabilities:
        skills: [evaluation, statistical-validation]
        tools: [read, calculate]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
      config: { threshold: 10 }
    - id: run-tests
      kind: agent
      name: Run compatible small-study-effect diagnostics
      templateRef: stat-01
      role: Meta-analysis statistician running small-study-effect and funnel-plot-asymmetry diagnostics.
      prompt: >-
        For each adequately powered outcome, choose funnel-plot-asymmetry tests that match the outcome type, effect
        measure, and heterogeneity; do not mechanically apply every available test. Report estimates, uncertainty,
        p-values, assumptions, and a funnel-plot or equivalent diagnostic when possible. Treat asymmetry as a
        small-study-effect signal with multiple possible causes, not proof of publication bias, and label analyses
        with fewer than 10 studies as underpowered.
      capabilities:
        skills: [statistical-analysis, statistical-validation, evidence-verification]
        tools: [read, calculate, render]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: bias-gate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Identify outcomes requiring sensitivity analysis
      role: Independent small-study-effect signal evaluator
      prompt: >-
        Evaluate each adequately powered outcome using the prespecified analysis plan, the compatibility and
        assumptions of each diagnostic, and the observed heterogeneity. Return no-signal when no outcome warrants
        sensitivity analysis; otherwise return has-signal with the exact outcomes, statistics, and alternative
        explanations that must be tested.
      capabilities:
        skills: [evaluation, statistical-validation, uncertainty-calibration]
        tools: [read, compare]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
      config: { threshold: 0.1 }
    - id: sensitivity
      kind: agent
      name: Run prespecified robustness analyses
      templateRef: stat-02
      role: Meta-analysis statistician evaluating robustness under declared sensitivity scenarios.
      prompt: >-
        For each flagged outcome, run only prespecified and methodologically compatible sensitivity analyses, such
        as influence diagnostics, leave-one-out analysis, alternative estimators, or a cautiously interpreted
        trim-and-fill analysis. Compare effect direction, magnitude, interval estimates, and decision thresholds
        with the primary model. Return robust, fragile, or reversed with assumptions and limitations; do not use a
        fail-safe N or an imputed funnel as proof that missing evidence has been resolved.
      capabilities:
        skills: [statistical-analysis, statistical-validation, uncertainty-calibration]
        tools: [read, calculate]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: recommendation
      kind: agent
      name: Interpret diagnostics and formulate review caveats
      templateRef: clin-16
      role: Senior methodologist interpreting publication-bias diagnostics for a systematic review.
      prompt: >-
        Interpret the small-study-effect diagnostics and sensitivity analyses outcome by outcome. Distinguish
        funnel-plot asymmetry from proven publication bias, consider heterogeneity and other plausible causes, and
        state whether to report the original estimate, an adjusted estimate, or both. Explain any implication for
        certainty of evidence and give a plain-language caveat tied to the actual test statistics, assumptions, and
        limitations.
      capabilities:
        skills: [clinical-evidence-appraisal, statistical-analysis, uncertainty-calibration, writing-editing]
        tools: [read, compare]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: merge-report
      kind: transform
      name: Merge unflagged, underpowered, and sensitivity-reported outcomes
      config: { operation: merge, expression: $.unflagged + $.underpowered + $.sensitivityReported by outcome }
    - id: bias-lead-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Review lead approves the diagnostics, caveats, and limitations
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved small-study-effect diagnostics and sensitivity report
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: meta-analysis-input, to: power-check, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: power-check, to: run-tests, kind: control, condition: has-testable }
    - { id: e3, from: power-check, to: bias-lead-approval, kind: control, condition: all-underpowered }
    - { id: e4, from: run-tests, to: bias-gate, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: bias-gate, to: merge-report, kind: control, condition: no-signal }
    - { id: e6, from: bias-gate, to: sensitivity, kind: control, condition: has-signal }
    - { id: e7, from: sensitivity, to: recommendation, kind: data }
    - { id: e8, from: recommendation, to: merge-report, kind: data }
    - { id: e9, from: merge-report, to: bias-lead-approval, kind: data }
    - { id: e10, from: bias-lead-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
